chunks: And Mūsā ibn Bakr narrated from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A slave-girl/girl is not to be consummated with until nine years or ten years come for her.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.رَوَىٰ: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurārah, the transmitter in the sanad
key_terms.يُدْخَلُ: it is consummated; refers here to marital consummation

ai.seo_question: At what age does this hadith say consummation with a girl may take place?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the timing of consummation with a young girl. It places a minimum age threshold of nine or ten years in the wording of the report.
